dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. May I have the check, please?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. meɪ aɪ ˈhæv ðə ˈtʃɛk, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is there a service charge on the check?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ɪz ðɛr ə ˈsɜːrvɪs ˌtʃɑːrdʒ ɑːn ðə ˈtʃɛk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. There's a ten percent service charge.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛrz ə ˈtɛn pərˈsɛnt ˈsɜːrvɪs ˌtʃɑːrdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then we don't need to leave a big tip.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn wiː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd tə ˈliːv ə ˈbɪɡ ˈtɪp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Should we split the bill, or pay separately?
dialogue.reading: ʃʊd wiː ˈsplɪt ðə ˈbɪl, ɔːr ˈpeɪ ˈsɛpərətli?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You can pay separately. I can split the bill for you.
dialogue.reading: juː kən ˈpeɪ ˈsɛpərətli. aɪ kən ˈsplɪt ðə ˈbɪl fər juː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. May I pay by card?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. meɪ aɪ ˈpeɪ baɪ ˈkɑːrd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And I'll pay cash. Here's five hundred baht. Keep the change!
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪl ˈpeɪ ˈkæʃ. hɪrz ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt. ˈkiːp ðə ˈtʃeɪndʒ!
